concerns.text: Task T033 (Correlation) and T035 (VIF) explicitly depend on T026 (descriptors.csv), but T026 is marked [ ] (uncompleted) in Phase 4. Phase 5 tasks cannot be executed or tested until T026 is completed. This violates the 'Producer before consumer' rule for the data-flow artifact `data/processed/descriptors.csv`.

Task T036 (Bootstrapping) and T037 (Sensitivity) depend on T024 (Model artifacts), which is marked [ ] (uncompleted) in Phase 4. The 'Checkpoint' note in Phase 5 admits US3 is not testable until T024/T026 are complete, yet these tasks are listed as active implementation items in Phase 5 without a blocking dependency resolution.

Task T024a and T024b (Model artifacts) are marked [ ] (uncompleted) but are prerequisites for Phase 5. The 'Checkpoint' at the end of Phase 4 states 'User Stories 1 AND 2 should both work independently', which is impossible if T024 (the core output of US2) is not completed. This creates a logical contradiction in the ordering.

Task T039 (Report visualizations) depends on T036 and T037, but T039 is listed before T049/T050 (Report text generation). While T049/T050 depend on T039, the ordering of T039 relative to T036/T037 is correct, but the dependency chain T024 -> T036/T037 -> T039 -> T049/T050 is broken by the uncompleted status of T024. The text should clarify that T039 is blocked until T024 is resolved.

Task T059 (Stratification edge case) and T060 (Collinearity condition number) are placed in Phase 5 but depend on T022 (LOFO split) and T035 (VIF) respectively. T022 is in Phase 4 (completed), but T035 is in Phase 5 (uncompleted). T060 cannot run before T035. The ordering within Phase 5 must ensure T035 precedes T060.
